root_cause: order-service deploy D-3303 (v2.14.0) reduced db.pool.max from 50 to 5; the pool saturated and requests timed out acquiring connections (3000 ms), producing 503s at the gateway
impact: 503 errors and ~3 s latency on order-service routes (/api/orders*, /api/shipments/*) from about 09:19 to 10:08 UTC on 2026-09-14
mitigation: rollback D-3304 to v2.13.4 at 10:05 UTC; recovered by 10:08 UTC
red_herrings: payment-service TLS expiry warnings (11-12 days left, auto-renewal scheduled)
follow_ups: validate Helm values in CI (pool size bounds)
